implementation_status: LOCAL_VERIFIED; no remaining implementation blocker observed in this verification
root_causes: Equivalent intents queried an unstable replica separately without an authoritative pinned dataset or durable latest-snapshot selection.
The old relative timestamp check skipped missing/malformed timestamps, lacked dataset/scope/version binding and could be bypassed by a 304 without verified snapshot evidence.
Snapshot ordering alone accepted severely lagging live replicas; the deployment interfaces lacked a configurable absolute age policy.
304 reuse could retain only accepted records instead of the complete source capture and did not reparse unresolved records under the requested processing policy.
The source adapter omitted authoritative official/short/alternate multilingual name mappings; all 15 investigated Cairo nodes nevertheless genuinely lack names across the available captures.
The four way centers were intentionally withheld as unverified entrances; valid derived centers existed and required explicit opt-in, provenance and lower confidence.
Unicode/empty-value/Arabic comparison normalization was incomplete, ATM word order was awkward, and name conflation could overwrite the selected field metadata.

Derived coordinate confidence was not retained in final records; timeout/retry handling lacked a total data-request budget and cancellation/stream/cooldown checks; HTTP 200 partial timeout responses also needed explicit rejection.
fixes: Timestamp/version validation, canonical snapshot and semantic scope hashes, durable latest-version guard, equal-timestamp dataset conflict rejection and stale publication checks.
Integrity-bound snapshot metadata, explicit pinned historical captures, no automatic stale fallback and 24-hour live-age defaults in CLI/API.
Full-capture conditional response integrity/latest/age validation and deterministic reparse.
Authoritative alternate-name mapping with selected-field provenance; explicit unnamed status/reason without invented names.
Opt-in source center recovery with original payload/footprint reference, derived flag/method/derivation and 0.35 confidence in normalized records and published attributes.
Deterministic Unicode, whitespace, diacritic/tatweel and alias normalization, bilingual preservation, ATM generic translation and uncertainty retained.

Socket/stream/transport cooldown budgets, provider Retry-After compliance, bounded retries and explicit cancellation/failure without output mutation; HTTP 200 remarks/errors and missing element arrays cannot masquerade as complete datasets.
Regenerated the same 100 synthetic review inputs for rules-v3; no human ratings added.
